title: Berge's theorem, the Tutte–Berge formula and the Gallai–Edmonds theorem
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Berge's augmenting path theorem (a matching is maximum if and only if there is no augmenting path) and of the Tutte–Berge formula (the maximum size of a matching is the minimum over vertex sets U of (|V| + |U| − odd(G − U)) / 2), with the weak inequality for all matchings and vertex sets; the formula is derived from Mathlib's Tutte theorem by adding universal vertices. Version 2 adds the Gallai–Edmonds structure theorem: with D the vertices missed by some maximum matching, A their neighbours outside D and C the rest, the components of G[D] are factor-critical, G[C] has a perfect matching, every maximum matching matches A into distinct components of G[D], and 2ν(G) = |V| + |A| − c(G[D]).
